fusions.name: Hushed Bloom
fusions.desc: Releases a cone of spores that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it, with a 60% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Rot Feed
fusions.desc: A swipe that uses up one of your afflictions on the target, dealing 8 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lichen Lick
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spore-Seeded
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% plant resistance for as long as you carry it.
